==Description==
To be placed before sections of articles that describe specifically defined paths in a [[roleplaying game]], where such a choice has not specifically been declared canon.

==Usage==
Use the format <code><nowiki>{{RPG|</nowiki>{{Var|Wikilinked and formatted name of game}}}}</code> for a specific adventure. The {{Para|canon|1}} parameter should be used for [[Canon]] articles. Close assumption sections with <code>{{Tl|Endgame}}</code>.
